title: Legacy flag map (migration only)
description: data/registry/flag-map.json (DATA-PIPELINE §8): how today's raw-data.csv rows become legacy facts. Versioned; tested on every row. This schema covers the cost methods per source (so rows whose flags name no method are mapped source by source, with evidence) and effort values; flag → fact rules for the other prefixes are added as they are written.

cost_method_by_source.description: Legacy source spelling (raw-data.csv `source`) → its cost method. applies = unmapped: only rows whose flags match no vocab cost_method pattern; all: every cost row of the source (the source's own documentation overrides our flags).

groups.description: Restrict to these raw-data.csv groups (default: all groups of the source).

effort_values.description: Legacy effort value → what it becomes (vocab legacy_effort).
